verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client app, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack documents a GitHub MCP server, but only for use from Copilot Chat in the IDE. That is a capability of the broader GitHub platform, not of GitHub Mobile, so it earns no credit here, and nothing shows GitHub Mobile itself exposing an MCP server for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
